title: OTP or password request
why: Asks for a secret code. Never share these.

title: Payment request
why: Colleges do charge fees, so verify the payee independently.
pattern: (registration fee|processing fee|refundable deposit|deposit|pay now|pay (?:rs\.?|₹)\s?\d+|\bfees?\b|send money|paisa bhejo|paise bhejo)

title: Urgency
why: Pressure to act fast. Urgency alone is not proof.

title: Chain-forward request
why: Common in scam forwards, not proof.
